subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544, or request a fresh same-repository replacement for this Channels settings resolver fix?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open linked PR already contains the focused resolver/test approach and blocks duplicate automated repair work; adoption versus replacement is maintainer workflow judgment.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it onto the current UI path and add current real Control UI proof.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Leave the fork PR aside and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver PR with focused regression coverage and proof.

options.title: Decline the discovery-card behavior
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR only if maintainers decide custom-only snapshots should intentionally hide unconfigured built-in channel cards.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it onto the current UI path and add current real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for the channel UI metadata/catalog path and the adoption-versus-replacement decision.
